data.raw_text: There will very likely be major plastics related product shortages in Southeast Asia and East Asia (excluding China) that will take a year to resolve, with higher prices for those products being part of the outcome. I would expect to see most products in the Philippines that are purchased in small sachets hit very hard. In other words, this will hit the poorest the hardest in terms of the percentage of income that will be diverted to purchase the same products. Manufacturers might instead decide to take advantage of this as an opportunity to find alternative methods of delivering small amounts of products- but until they do, expect prices in Sari-Sari stores for example to begin to go up in the next several months. Given the amount of plastic waste generated in Southeast Asia, now would be a great time for the Philippines, as the @ASEAN chair @DFAPHL to rally for changes that could ultimately benefit the environment. Less plastic waste could be a potential upside to this crisis if ASEAN member states look for opportunities and work collectively to implement changes.
